classes.light_extractive_local: Light extractive/transformative task within local capability and context limits.
classes.high_volume_batch_local: Batch/map workload where per-item cost dominates; local tier at zero marginal cost.
classes.privacy_local_required: Task flagged privacy-sensitive; must not leave the local tier.
classes.budget_conservation_downroute: Frontier/mid budget pressure; task downrouted to a cheaper capable executor.
classes.boilerplate_draft_mid: Routine drafting (docs, descriptions, templates) suited to the mid tier.
classes.low_risk_code_mid: Low-risk, well-scoped code with clear acceptance criteria; mid tier suffices.
classes.mechanical_refactor_mid: Mechanical, pattern-driven code transformation; mid tier with review step.
classes.history_failure_escalation: A cheaper tier previously failed or escalated on this task class; routing one tier up.
classes.long_context_capability_gate: Context length exceeds the preferred tier's window; gated to a longer-context executor.
classes.capability_gate_local_unfit: Task class not within the local executor's declared capabilities.
classes.fleet_gap_fail_up: Preferred tier absent from the fleet registry; failing up to the next available tier.
classes.ambiguity_fail_up: Task is underspecified/ambiguous; resolving uncertainty toward the more capable tier.
classes.correctness_critical_frontier: Correctness-critical work (user-facing, hard logic); frontier required.
classes.security_sensitive_frontier: Security-relevant code or review; frontier required regardless of size.
classes.architecture_design_frontier: Architecture/design decisions with long-lived consequences; frontier required.
classes.complex_reasoning_frontier: Multi-step reasoning, hard debugging, or mathematics; frontier required.
